import random, time, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen2
rng = random.Random(11)
t0=time.time()
reqs=[]
for i in range(40):
    ts=time.time()
    r=gen2.gen(rng)
    reqs.append(r)
    dt=time.time()-ts
    if dt > 0.3: print('gen slow', i, round(dt,2), r['node_count'], len(r['edges']), len(r['commodities']), sum(len(c['paths']) for c in r['commodities']))
print('gen total', round(time.time()-t0,2))
print('sizes', max(len(r['edges']) for r in reqs), max(sum(len(c['paths']) for c in r['commodities']) for r in reqs))
payload=''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in reqs).encode()
print('payload bytes', len(payload))
t1=time.time()
import subprocess
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=payload,capture_output=True)
print('solve total', round(time.time()-t1,2), 'rc', p.returncode)
print('stderr', p.stderr.decode()[:500])
